QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: anchorRadius
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The vehicle must stay within this distance of the locked point before the anchor is considered settled. 0 disables the settle gate. Keep it above the position-hold accuracy of the vehicle: a radius below the noise floor never latches and the anchor stretches to its guard timeout.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: anchorSettle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Uninterrupted time the vehicle must stay inside the settle radius before the anchor duration starts counting. Leaving the radius resets this timer.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: anchorGuard
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Overall ceiling on a single anchor command, counted from when it starts. Guarantees the mission advances even if the vehicle can never settle, or never finishes turning. 0 lets the firmware work one out from the duration, the pre-shutter wait and whether there is a turn.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: photoBefore
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Wait between finishing the camera turn and firing the shutter, so the vehicle has stopped swinging when the photo is taken. With Anchor on this runs inside the anchor command (max 31 s); without it, it is a CONDITION_DELAY item.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: photoWindow
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: How long the vehicle stays on the point. With Anchor on this is the plain hold AFTER the shutter, because the anchor sequences the turn and the shutter itself. Without Anchor it is the whole photo window and has to outlast the turn plus the delay above, otherwise AP_Mission drops the queue and no photo is taken.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: startWait
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Start hold before the position fix
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: How long the vehicle holds the point it was placed on, at the start of the mission, before the navigation solution is snapped onto the plan's start coordinate and the first dive begins. The vehicle is driven onto the start marker by hand, so this is the window in which it stops moving and the estimator settles: snapping while it is still gliding writes that glide straight back into the solution. 0 removes the hold and the position fix together.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: diveSettle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hold on the dive-in-place waypoint. ArduSub declares a waypoint reached within WPNAV_RADIUS in 3D, so a short vertical leg completes while the vehicle is still shallow. This hold keeps the mission on the dive waypoint until it is actually at cruise depth.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: surfaceSettle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hold on the surface waypoint after ascending, before the camera turn and shutter sequence starts.
